dog.description_text: Meet Keisha — New Arrival! Keisha just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FKeisha%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQrdiV7OJAEqRKD4Aa30FxGNEgUD7hFapaHU%2D02E%5Fg8TQoW7DA Her foster says she is a ""Sweet, affectionate, talkative, playful, sidekick, snuggle bug ...24 hours in and Keisha is already confident and affectionate! She seeks out pets and loves to flirt flop. Very sweet and talkative. Loves being brushed and using the scratcher. She is very sweet, affectionate, and easy going. Talkative but not disruptive." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
